description.p: YQT plays YouTube Music in a small native window built with Qt and Kirigami, so it looks and behaves like the rest of a Plasma desktop: your colour scheme, your window decorations, media keys, a tray icon.

ul.li: Home, Explore, search, and your library, liked songs and history when signed in
A queue with drag-to-reorder, radio after a single song, gapless playback and crossfade
Synced lyrics from LRCLIB, NetEase and YouTube Music
Downloads for offline listening, with rules for what to keep
An equaliser, a mini-player, and configurable keyboard shortcuts

description.p: Signing in imports your YouTube session from a browser on this computer; it is only ever sent to YouTube. YQT is not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
